composition_subtypes.role: compute subtree leaf counts via post-order DP
sort leaf counts to determine min colors for each k

payload.core_composition_summary: DFS-based tree DP computes leaf count per node; sorting yields k-th smallest as min colors for k happy junctions.
payload.rationale: The solution first uses tree DP to calculate the number of leaves in each subtree. Then it sorts these values, which directly correspond to the minimum number of colors needed to achieve at least k happy junctions. Both steps are essential and independent mechanisms.
